lessons.key: surviving_mutant::a privilege assertion for anon must cover column level grants not only has table privilege a column grant leaves the table level check false
lessons.text: A privilege assertion for anon must cover column-level grants, not only has_table_privilege — a column grant leaves the table-level check false.

lessons.text: Pin in the spec the exact text of any label an end user reads before asserting that string in the suite.

lessons.text: Exercite campos opcionais do payload nos dois estados — ausente e null explícito — ao testar a camada que persiste, senão o coalescing para null fica sem cobertura.
